About the project

A food website designed around the moments people gather, with generous photography, editorial type, and a practical route from the menu to an enquiry.

Client
Mohamed Zayaan · The Quality Kitchen
Year
2026
Role
Design and development
Technology
Next.js · Tailwind CSS · Vercel
Typical build window
2–3 weeks
Scope
Website design & development · Menu and ordering experience · Responsive interface design
Website
Open live project

A menu that helps people choose

Bring the food, the story, and the ordering details into one place. Visitors need to understand the offering, choose the right portions, and reach the kitchen without a complicated checkout.

Portions sorted before the message

A photography-led homepage introduces the kitchen and its food. A filterable menu, portion selection, and a gathering basket turn browsing into an organised WhatsApp enquiry.

Inside the website

  • Food photography and editorial typography

  • Filterable menu for finding dishes

  • Portion selection and a gathering basket

  • WhatsApp ordering and direct enquiries

From basket to kitchen

The basket puts selected dishes and portions into a WhatsApp message the customer can review and send.

Visual direction

A dark editorial palette frames the food, while warm accents and large serif headlines give the site the feel of a considered hospitality brand.
